messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — final checklist for LDN meetup next week. Need quick confirmations: booth layout, speaker materials, swag, lead routing.
Mai: Booth layout is the 3x2 island, table + monitor confirmed. We can add a standing demo kiosk.
Sam: AV: HDMI + power + ethernet requested. Can ops confirm ethernet patch? :pray:
Chris: Ops confirmed patch. Will bring a 10m cable and switch. ETA setup crew 7am.
Emily: Speaker materials — slides uploaded to drive: https://drive.reddemo/ldn-slides. Need prints (one-pager) 40 copies?
Alex: Yes 40 copies. Design approved. Mai will handle print shop pickup.
Mai: On it. Printing done Friday, driver booked.
Sam: Swag — we ordered 400 stickers, 150 tees, 200 mini-notebooks. Last check: tee sizes?
Chris: Tees are mixed S-2XL per sign-up form. 40% M/L, 30% S, rest XL+.
Emily: For lead capture, we should use QR landing page that triggers instant demo follow-up + webinar sign-up.
Alex: Agreed. Sam, can you confirm QR points to benchmark landing with demo scheduling and webinar registration?
Sam: QR will point to /london-meetup?utm=qr — has form for email + company + checkbox: 'book demo'.
Chris: Routing: demos go to SDRs (EMEA queue). Webinar signups go to Growth inbox. How do we tag leads?
Alex: Tag as source=ldn_meetup and interest=demo or webinar. SDRs get immediate slack notification.
Emily: I'll add UTM and lead field mapping in the sheet. Also add a 'benchmark interest' checkbox.
Mai: Speaking submissions — we got accepted for 15min talk. Who's speaker? Alex volunteered.
Alex: I'll confirm slides by Thurs. Need 1 slide with cost/latency benchmarks and 2 short customer examples.
Sam: Can we show a live shortcode demo? Concerned about wifi. Recommend pre-record + short clip.
Chris: Agree. Use pre-record and have a 30s backup clip on USB.
Emily: Shipping: swag + booth kit to venue by Friday morning. Tracking number to be shared.
Mai: I have courier contact. Shipping label created. ETA Thursday EOD to venue warehouse.
Alex: Post-event plan: send webinar invite to all scanned leads within 48h, SDRs to follow up hot leads <24h.
Sam: Also schedule 3 social posts: pre-event promo, on-day booth story, and post-event highlight with benchmark thread.
Emily: I'll draft copy and tag design review. Need speaker photo + 1 quote from product.
Chris: Volunteer shifts — we have: Mai 9-12, Sam 12-3, Alex 3-6, Emily floating for demos. Need one more for 11-2 overlap.
Mai: I'll ask support team for an extra head for midday.
Logistics Bot: Reminder: Venue requires proof of insurance by Fri 12:00. Upload to vendor portal.
Alex: Who's owner for insurance upload? Chris?
Chris: I'll upload by Thursday morning.
Mai: Anything else?
Sam: Can we add a quick badge sticker 'Book a demo' to handouts with QR? Increases conversions.
Emily: Great idea. I'll include sticker in print list.
Alex: Thanks everyone — if no blockers, we'll lock this and reconvene Thursday standup to confirm prints & shipping.
Mai: No blockers from design.
Sam: All clear from ops.
Chris: Insurance and AV confirmed.
Emily: Copy drafted, will share in #marketing-drafts.
Alex: :thumbsup:
